title: Saffron Retail — outbound + pilot scratchpad
content:
Top-line: Saffron is a mid-market omnichannel home-goods retailer (~120 stores, heavy holiday seasonality). They run Magento + custom microservices for search and recommendations. Current search provider is Algolia; have engineering debt around migrations. Opportunity: pilot Redwood inference for site search augmentation + CSR chat assistant to reduce returns and call volume.

Primary goals (what they said in initial brief):
- Improve search relevance for long-tail queries (reduce 0-results)
- Deflect customer support queries via bots (order status, returns)
- Maintain sub-400ms P50 latency for search augmentation widgets
- Keep customer PII out of vendor logs (data residency / isolation requirement for EU customers)

Key stakeholders (to reach):
- Elena Morales — Head of Product (owner for experiments)
- Vikram Shah — CTO (infrastructure + compliance sign-off)
- Claire Dorsey — Head of CX / Ops (measures deflection / CS KPIs)
- Ben Torres — Senior SRE (latency / rollout)
- Procurement: Lena Ortiz (proc timeline Q2)

Notes from discovery call (2/6/25):
- Elena: wants a quick demo showing relevance lift on holiday categories; cares about A/B testing and rollback controls.
- Vikram: worried about data leaking to hosted providers; asked if Redwood Private or Dedicated can meet EU data residency and KMS requirements.
- Claire: target is 15% deflection on simple support queries within 6 weeks of pilot.
- Tech stack: Magento + Redis caching layer + ELK for logs. They have GA4 and internal analytics.

Proposed pilot (high level):
- Duration: 6 weeks (4 weeks active + 2 weeks prep/validation)
- Scope: 1) site search augmentation (autocomplete + result re-rank); 2) small CS assistant on returns/faq flows (web chat, not voice).
- Traffic slice: 10% of search queries (holiday categories), peak throttling allowed 50 QPS for test.
- Model profile: start with open LLM (redwood-legacy-7b-quant) for latency; fallback to hosted-larger for quality on canary.
- Infra: Redwood Dedicated in eu-west + optional Private VPC if procurement demands. Provide KMS integration example.
- Success metrics: +3% CTR to product detail pages from search, 15% CS deflection, mean latency < 450ms p95 for the augmentation endpoint.
- Data handling: enable prefix- and KV-cache; redact PII before logging; propose SSO + scoped API keys.

Outbound sequence (drafts) — keep short, reference value and quick ask:
1) Email 1 (intro)
Subject: quick idea to cut CS volume for Saffron this season
Hi Elena — saw your holiday promo on Instagram, congrats. I work on partnerships at Redwood Inference — we help retailers run high-performance search and chat assistants that reduce CS load and speed up conversions. Quick idea: 6-week pilot (no risky migrations) to test search re-rank + a returns bot on a 10% traffic slice. Can I share a one‑page pilot plan?
Best, Jordan

2) Email 2 (follow-up + social proof) — 3 days later
Subject: 2 retailers saw 12–18% deflection — pilot plan attached
Hi Elena — folks we partnered with (mid-market retail) saw ~15% chat deflection in 4 weeks; attached a short case study and an agenda for a 20-minute sync. Are you free Tue or Wed next week?

3) LinkedIn/DM template
Hi Elena — Jordan from Redwood. Sent a quick email about a low-risk search + chat pilot. Happy to share a concise plan if useful?

Discovery / call script (20 min):
- 0–3 min: quick intros + reason for call
- 3–8 min: confirm goals & current pain (search zero-results, returns volume, SLAs)
- 8–14 min: walk through pilot outline + infra options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
- 14–17 min: constraints & timeline (procurement, security, peak season)
- 17–20 min: close: propose dates for pilot kickoff + assign internal owners

Key discovery questions (quick):
- What % of CS tickets are returns and order status? (Claire)
- Do you store order IDs or PII in search queries? any redaction today? (Ben/Vikram)
- What traffic slice is safe to experiment with (0–10%, 10–25%)?
- Who owns infra approvals for third‑party inference (Dedicated/Private)?
- Payment/procurement constraints (PO, legal SLA minimums)?

Objections + quick rebuttals (to arm AE):
- "We can't send PII to hosted vendors." -> We can run pilot on Redwood Dedicated with customer‑managed KMS or Redwood Private in your VPC; logs are configurable and we support on-prem packaging for sensitive flows.
- "Costs look high vs self-hosting open models." -> Show unit economics: with batching, KV caching, and route policies we typically reduce per‑token cost vs naive self‑hosted setups and avoid ops overhead. Offer ROI calc: estimated tokens for 10% search slice = 5M tokens/mo; incremental revenue from CTR + conversion = $X — propose a minimal committed trial credit.
- "Integration effort is large." -> We provide a 2‑engineer integration template: JS widget + server-side re-rank hook + sample prompt set; typical integration 2–3 sprints. Also offer a Solutions Engineer pairing session.
- "Hallucinations / incorrect answers in chat." -> Start with retrieval-augmented prompts + guardrails (tool calling to fetch order status by order ID). Provide human-in-loop fallback and confidence scoring for ambiguous replies.

Technical checklist (things to prep before pilot):
- Access: dev API key (scoped), sample search query logs (anonymized), corpus for retrieval (product catalog + FAQs).
- Infra: decide dedicated vs private; confirm SRE contact for routing + CORS.
- Metrics: GA4 events for clicks, Instrument search widget to capture p50/p95 latency, CS ticket tagging for deflection.
- Security: confirm KMS vendor (AWS KMS or Azure KeyVault), legal NDA (copy), data retention window.

Demo plan (30 min) — what to show in first live session:
- 5m: problem & metrics baseline (existing zero-results, CS volumes)
- 10m: live demo — search augmentation (before/after re-rank) + chat assistant handling returns (retrieve order status via fake ID)
- 10m: infra options + rollout controls (canary, automatic fallback, logging)
- 5m: next steps & timeline

Pilot pricing (sketch for initial commercial discussion):
- 6-week pilot: flat fee $15k + token usage discount (up to 5M tokens incl), optional Dedicated seat + infra add-on to cover reserved capacity if they want isolation. Note: pricing is negotiable — goal is to remove friction.

Open questions / follow-ups for internal team:
- Ava: prepare anonymized consumer search sample (top 1k queries) to demo relevance lift — due 3/14.
- Ravi: prepare ROI back-of-envelope (revenue per session uplift) — due 3/12.
- Legal: is there a standard Private deployment playbook for EU retail customers? who owns it? (Maya to ping security)
- Product: can we show A/B test dashboards from Redwood Console for similar customers? (ask PD)

Notes to self (rambling):
- Avoid too many technical terms in first email — focus on business outcome.
- Elena asked about rollback policies — emphasize canary + automatic fallback to existing search.
- Put procurement contact on intro thread early; they will want clear SLA and data handling appendix.

Quick action items (today):
- Send Email 1 (version A) to Elena + cc Vikram by EOD.
- Prep 5-min demo script + 3 screenshots of re-rank before/after for the call.
- Book 20-minute intro with Claire (ops) and Ben (SRE) for next week.

Attachment ideas to send with email: one-pager pilot plan (single page PDF), short case study (1–2 pages), example A/B dashboard screenshot, security appendix (KMS / Private options).

Versions: keep this doc as living scratchpad. Rename final pilot plan to: saffron-pilot-one-pager-final.pdf when ready.

-- end of notes --
